propositions: Module size distribution metric scans src/rebar/**/*.py at a git ref and counts modules against the single-sourced hard cap in .github/module-size-limit.txt, returning count, near_cap_count, over_cap_count, and max_loc.
Cap change events metric extracts old_limit and new_limit from git log history of .github/module-size-limit.txt over a range, returning a list of commit dicts (empty list when no cap changes occur).
Churn metric sums insertions and deletions from git log --numstat over a time range, returning exact totals as a dict.
Refactor-to-addition ratio metric computes deletions/insertions from numstat; returns float ratio when insertions > 0, returns None when insertions == 0.

All four git metrics are registered in c085 REGISTRY with lens=code_health, source=git, confidence=high, and are invoked via context-adapter computes that extract repo_root, since, until from the metrics context.

Test coverage includes fixture git repos with known module sizes and numstat outputs, asserting exact metric values; registration tests verify all four metric ids are present in REGISTRY with correct labels.
